example.name: bug_report_to_pr_workflow
example.scenario: User reports a bug: "App crashes when opening settings without internet."

step.description: Analyze and copyedit prompt into structured GitHub issue format (excluding internal Acceptance Criteria).
Retrieve repo owner and name via git config --get remote.origin.url (lazy identity lookup deferred until assignment is needed).
Search existing issues for duplicates; none found.
Hard Stop Gate #1: Present drafted issue Markdown to the user and halt execution. Do NOT call create_issue in the same turn.
Upon user approval, call GitHub MCP create_issue tool, receiving issue #123 (left open; never manually closed via API).

Ask user if we should attempt a fix (Gate #2). Upon approval, leave issue unassigned, create branch issue-123-offline-settings-fix (following strict regex pattern ^issue-[0-9]+-[a-z0-9-]+$), and delegate implementation exclusively to Code or Orchestrator mode (github-issue mode performs zero file editing directly).
Upon return from fix mode, inspect git diff and test output. Hit Hard Stop Gate #3: present review to user and wait for explicit approval before any commit, push, or PR creation.

Upon approval, commit changes on branch issue-123-offline-settings-fix with raw reference Fix settings crash when offline (Fixes #123), push branch to origin (never pushing directly to main), and open a rich Pull Request via create_pull_request with standalone closing keyword Fixes #123.

Mandatory Phase 6 Lifecycle Completion: Offer PR merge directly without pre-evaluation. If approved, attempt merge_pull_request (handling any failure plainly without retries). Restore local workspace to default branch via git checkout main && git pull, and delete feature branch upon successful merge (or keep remote branch if merge failed).

example.completion: Successfully created GitHub issue #123 (after Hard Stop Gate #1 approval), coordinated code fix exclusively via delegation to implementation sub-mode on strict regex-compliant branch issue-123-offline-settings-fix, passed Hard Stop Gate #3, committed, pushed to feature branch, opened rich PR via `create_pull_request`, executed Phase 6 (offered and attempted PR merge with graceful error handling, restored local workspace to main via git checkout main && git pull, and cleaned up branch). Task successfully completed.
